verdict.rationale: GitHub documents first-party CI/CD through GitHub Actions, which lets you automate and run development workflows 'right in your repository', implying pipelines defined as code (github-docs-38, github-docs-11). A community report also confirms teams use its CI/CD (github-comm-19). However, nothing in the pack states that workflows are written in YAML, describes the workflow file format, or explains the syntax. missing for 10: explicit evidence of YAML workflow syntax, documentation of the pipeline-definition file format and structure, hands-on corroboration of defining pipelines as code.
